status: model of the internal generation Worker built from subnet/gen-worker (slop-ninja-gen-testnet). Nothing in it is measured on this Worker yet: the JS reserve, glue costs and stack are the coordinator model's inputs (the same workers-rs 0.8.7, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions, the same hand-written export pattern), so the build uses the arena's unmeasured-model feature, which the arena accepts only together with observe, and links growable linear memory under the ceiling below. A call admits its own memory from what it declares, inside its scope, before allocating: the call message as one block of its declared length (at most the interface bound), its parse, then, before the vendor is contacted, the stream reader's two buffers, the reply and a Flex retry's body. Several calls share an isolate; a call the isolate cannot hold answers a throttle.
page_bytes_source: WebAssembly page size, equal to the dlmalloc 0.2.12 system granularity
isolate_bytes_source: Cloudflare Workers limits: "128 MB per isolate", read as 10^6 bytes, the smaller of the two readings
js_reserve_bytes_source: the coordinator model's value (a linear memory ceiling of 1,536 pages), kept so the models share one unmeasured JS reserve until this Worker's is measured through the inspector
js_envelope_bytes_source: not measured: twice the largest body this Worker holds in JS before admitting it into linear memory, the call message at the interface bound (iface::CALL_MESSAGE_BYTES, 4 MiB + 64 KiB), rounded to 8 MiB
glue_static_bytes_source: the workers-rs 0.8.7 glue probe (subnet/crates/arena/glue-probe/memory-model.json, local workerd 2026-10-23, round2 run probe1): idle glue 872 B (hand-written exports), rounded up to the next power of two as the stated margin; this crate's lockfile pins the same worker, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions
glue_ticket_bytes_source: the glue probe's largest measured glue per entry with every export hand-written, one ticket per entry: 304 B (waitUntil continuation), rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker's hand-written fetch export (cf.rs) follows the probe's admitted pattern
glue_resident_bytes_source: the glue probe: 24 B per co-resident Durable Object instance, rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker defines no Durable Object class, so no resident is admitted
min_route_bytes_source: every route's control footprint (routes::CONTROL_BYTES, 1 MiB), checked by routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table
largest_route_bytes_source: a generate call at every interface bound: the control footprint (1 MiB), the call message block (iface::CALL_MESSAGE_BYTES), its parse (routes::parse_bytes of iface::CALL_BODY_BYTES), the call heap admitted before the vendor is contacted (iface::call_heap_bytes at the interface bounds: the reader's visible and line buffers, iface::VISIBLE_BYTES_MAX and iface::LINE_BYTES_MAX, the read buffer of one page, the reply at twice the visible bound plus a page, and a Flex standard retry's body at iface::CALL_BODY_BYTES), plus the scope's state page; checked by routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table
stack_bytes_source: rustc wasm32-unknown-unknown links the stack first with rust-lld's default -z stack-size=1048576 (scratch probe, 2026-10-31); the pool starts above static data, so the stack is outside every arena
stack_high_water_bytes_source: not measured on this build: the glue probe's 3,912 B (every workers-rs entry kind), a lower bound
